Something I Want You To Know 💗

Happy Birthday, Fatimah ❤️

Today is your special day, and I just wanted to make something that comes from the heart. We have been friends for around two and a half years now, and when I think about how much time has passed, it honestly feels incredible how important you have become to me.

Over these years, you have become someone I genuinely care about more than I can properly put into words. There are so many little conversations, moments, laughs and memories that may seem ordinary, but to me they are all pieces of a time that I will always value. Having you in my life has made these years more meaningful in ways you may not even realise.

I want you to know that my feelings for you are real. I love you, and I care about you deeply. You are one of the people whose happiness genuinely matters to me. Whenever you are happy, it makes me happy too, and whenever life gets difficult for you, I always wish I could somehow make things a little easier for you.

I do not know exactly what the future will look like, but I do know that the care and respect I have for you are not something I want to switch off just because time passes. I will keep wishing the best for you, cheering for your happiness, and caring about you in my own way. Some people become special slowly, through countless small moments, and that is exactly what happened with you.

You deserve beautiful things, beautiful days, genuine happiness and people who appreciate the person you are. I hope this new year of your life brings you closer to everything you dream about. I hope you smile more, worry less, and create memories that make you genuinely happy.

Thank you for being a part of these two and a half years. Thank you for all the memories, all the conversations and simply for being you. I may not always be able to say everything perfectly, but I hope this little page helps you understand even a small part of what you mean to me.

So once again, Happy Birthday, Fatimah. ❤️ I hope you have the most beautiful day and an even more beautiful year ahead. No matter how much time passes, I will always care about you and always want to see you happy.

With lots of love ❤️
